'''Avik Lore''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] overweight [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. He was once contracted to deliver a ship of [[Rock wart egg]]s to [[Siskeen/Legends|Siskeen]]. Avik took up smuggling after failing to make a living as a [[Musician/Legends|musician]], a [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]], and a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] owner. Lore was once friends with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] until he accidentally shot him. Lore would later get his revenge by betraying him in a smuggling mission, he grabbed a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and knocked Han unconscious, hoping to take all the profit from the mission for himself, and left him for [[Death/Legends|dead]]. However, Solo escaped.<ref name="Renegade" />

==Behind the scenes==
Avik Lore first and only appeared in the [[2009]] novel ''[[Rebel Force: Renegade]]'', written by [[Alex Wheeler]].
